# Przemysław Zalewski (Ciunkos)

> Przemysław Zalewski, known online as Ciunkos, is an independent senior full-stack engineer based in Wrocław, Poland, working in English and Polish with clients in the US, UK and EU. He builds web apps, SaaS products and AI agents in TypeScript, React and Node.js, ships on Cloudflare and measures products in PostHog. Hire page: [ciunkos.com/hire-me](https://ciunkos.com/hire-me) (Polish: [ciunkos.com/zatrudnij-mnie](https://ciunkos.com/zatrudnij-mnie)). Resume: [ciunkos.com/resume](https://ciunkos.com/resume).

## Free tools

- [Quote Desk](https://ciunkos.com/quote-desk): matches a customer inquiry (email, PDF, Excel or a photo of a list) to your own price list, flags unclear lines and exports a draft quote to Excel.
- [AI Visibility Desk](https://ciunkos.com/ai-visibility): asks your buyers' questions to an AI assistant every week and shows whether your brand is named and which pages are cited. Claude only today.
- [List Desk](https://ciunkos.com/email-list-validator): checks an email list in your browser for dead domains, null MX, disposable providers, typos and duplicates.
- [Eval Desk](https://ciunkos.com/ai-prompt-testing): runs test cases for an AI assistant after a prompt change and shows what regressed, what got fixed and what is unstable. Claude models.
- [Dashboard Desk](https://ciunkos.com/posthog-dashboard-generator): creates a growth dashboard in your own PostHog project and lists what your tracking is missing.
- [Vitals Desk](https://ciunkos.com/core-web-vitals-monitor): a free daily Core Web Vitals monitor; each page is loaded three times as a throttled mid-range phone, the median LCP, CLS, TBT, FCP and TTFB are kept with a screenshot, and an email goes out when a page gets slower. Public results get an SVG badge and JSON.
- [Email Test](https://ciunkos.com/email-spam-test): send one email to a test address and get a report on one-click unsubscribe, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, the Gmail and Yahoo sender rules and spam signals, with an AI panel of three models and fixes written for an AI agent.
- [Phishing email checker](https://ciunkos.com/phishing-email-checker): forward a suspicious email or upload the .eml file; three AI models and technical checks say whether it looks like spam or phishing and what to do.
- [Signature Desk](https://ciunkos.com/email-signature-generator): one email signature template for a whole team, as HTML for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail.
- [SPF, DKIM and DMARC checker](https://ciunkos.com/spf-dkim-dmarc-checker): grades a domain's email DNS, including MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI and DNSSEC.
- [BIMI checker](https://ciunkos.com/bimi-checker): checks the BIMI record, DMARC, the SVG logo and the VMC or CMC certificate.
- [Agent skills](https://ciunkos.com/skills): free, open-source skills for Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai and ChatGPT, each with its own page. [/przemo](https://ciunkos.com/skills/przemo) does the task and talks like Przemysław on Slack; [/indexnow](https://ciunkos.com/skills/indexnow) is the IndexNow missing from Google Search Console, requesting indexing in your signed-in browser until GSC reports its quota; [business-idea-validator](https://ciunkos.com/skills/business-idea-validator) scores an idea on ten rubrics. Source: github.com/Ciunkos/skills.
- [Software cost estimator](https://ciunkos.com/software-cost-estimator): places a project among real products with ranges, not a single number.
- [Build or buy](https://ciunkos.com/software-cost-estimator/build-or-buy): a SaaS subscription against your own app over 1, 3 or 5 years.
- [Legacy rewrite estimate](https://ciunkos.com/software-cost-estimator/legacy-rewrite): hours and cost of rewriting an old system, with and without coding agents.
- [App store ready](https://ciunkos.com/app-store-ready): what a web app is missing for the App Store and Google Play.
- [Runbook generator](https://ciunkos.com/runbook-generator): a RUNBOOK.md for a system only you know.
- [SLA calculator](https://ciunkos.com/sla-calculator): monthly fee, response times and a downtime budget for internal apps.
- [Local model or API?](https://ciunkos.com/local-llm-calculator): whether a local model fits your hardware and what it costs against an API.
- [Multi-tenant SaaS calculator](https://ciunkos.com/multi-tenant-saas-calculator): the work needed to sell a one-company system to others.
- [OpenAPI to MCP tools](https://ciunkos.com/mcp-tools-from-openapi): narrow MCP tools and a TypeScript server skeleton from an OpenAPI spec.
- [KSeF invoice validator](https://ciunkos.com/ksef-invoice-validator): checks a Polish FA(3) e-invoice against the official schema in your browser.
- [Quoting time calculator](https://ciunkos.com/rfq-automation-calculator): the hours spent turning inquiries into quotes and when automating it would pay off.
- [Business idea validator](https://ciunkos.com/business-idea-validator): an AI-scored report on a business idea with three cheap experiments.
- [Engagement configurator](https://ciunkos.com/engagement-configurator): hours, a price range and the earliest start date for a piece of work.
- [B2B vs UoP calculator](https://ciunkos.com/kalkulator-b2b-vs-uop-2026): a Polish B2B contract compared with employment for a whole year (Polish).
- [Korpo Tłumacz](https://ciunkos.com/korpo-tlumacz): translates corporate speak into plain Polish and back (Polish).
- [All apps and tools, including apps from 2007 to 2017](https://ciunkos.com/apps)
